verdict.rationale: Dunning-style payment retries are a fair question for a billing platform like Metronome, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that Metronome creates invoices in Stripe to collect payment, plus API request idempotency. There is no documented automatic retry of failed renewal payments, no ML or schedule-optimized cadence, and no measured churn recovery. Any retry behavior would belong to the integrated payment processor, not to Metronome itself.

support.subject: As a finance lead, failed renewal payments are retried automatically on an ML- or schedule-optimized cadence that measurably recovers involuntary churn
